ideas.pitch: Multimodal crop disease and pest infestation early warning system powered by Google Gemini and satellite imagery.
ideas.title: CropShield AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the regional focus on agriculture across Asia Pacific highlighted in the hackathon's prompt, making it immediately relevant to local judges looking for high-impact real-world solutions.

ideas.pitch: Real-time multilingual lecture summarization and interactive Q&A assistant tailored for under-resourced classrooms across Asia Pacific.
ideas.title: ClassroomVoice
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the specific 'from farmers to classrooms' thematic priority emphasized by the organizers, addressing regional educational accessibility gaps.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous multimodal supply chain compliance auditor that scans trade documents and logistics images to flag customs bottlenecks using Gemini.
ideas.title: SupplyLedger AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by processing unstructured multimodal logistics data into a coherent compliance score, matching the winning pattern of technical difficulty.

ideas.pitch: Offline-first clinical intake and diagnostic transcription assistant built for regional rural health clinics using Google AI models.
ideas.title: MediScribe APAC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a deeply felt regional problem in healthcare delivery, appealing directly to judges seeking practical, life-improving applications of Google AI.

ideas.pitch: Low-cost water quality and aquaculture monitoring system using computer vision to track fish health and river pollution levels via Gemini.
ideas.title: AquaMonitor AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision with environmental sustainability, a combination that stands out in regional APAC showcases for its tangible community impact.
